scope: LoRA/QLoRA source-reading pilot; not a whole-wiki accuracy certification

lora-v2.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models

qlora-v1.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs

summary.en: LoRA learns a low-rank update BA while W0 stays frozen.
summary.zh-TW: LoRA 訓練低秩更新 BA，W0 維持凍結。

limits.en: The rank constraint is on the update, not on the base matrix.
limits.zh-TW: 低秩限制作用於更新，不是基底矩陣。

review.scope: This claim and its limitation only; not the whole linked page.

summary.en: A linear LoRA update can be merged into base weights for inference.
summary.zh-TW: 線性 LoRA 更新可合併進基底權重以供推論。

limits.en: This is not a blanket latency guarantee for quantized deployment.
limits.zh-TW: 這不是所有量化部署都沒有額外延遲的保證。

review.scope: This claim and its limitation only; not the whole linked page.

summary.en: QLoRA uses 4-bit base storage and BF16 computation; only adapters are trained.
summary.zh-TW: QLoRA 的基底以 4-bit 儲存、BF16 運算，只訓練適配器。

review.scope: This claim and its limitation only; not the whole linked page.

summary.en: NF4 allocates quantization levels for normally distributed weights.
summary.zh-TW: NF4 為常態分布的權重配置量化階層。

limits.en: Optimality is conditional on the distribution, not universal.
limits.zh-TW: 最佳性有分布前提，不適用所有分布。

review.scope: This claim and its limitation only; not the whole linked page.

summary.zh-TW: 雙重量化壓縮量化常數。

limits.en: It does not mean quantizing the weights twice.

review.scope: This claim and its limitation only; not the whole linked page.

summary.en: Paged optimizers move state pages between CPU and GPU to handle memory spikes.
summary.zh-TW: 分頁最佳化器在 CPU 與 GPU 間搬移狀態頁，以處理記憶體尖峰。

limits.en: The paper does not establish no slowdown for every workload.
limits.zh-TW: 論文未證明任何工作負載都不降速。

review.scope: This claim and its limitation only; not the whole linked page.

summary.en: The authors report 65B-model fine-tuning on one 48 GB GPU.
summary.zh-TW: 作者報告在單張 48 GB GPU 上微調 650 億參數模型。

limits.en: This is configuration-specific, not a universal memory guarantee.
limits.zh-TW: 這是特定配置結果，不是通用記憶體保證。

review.scope: This claim and its limitation only; not the whole linked page.

summary.en: Full-fine-tuning comparisons reach 3B; 7B–65B comparisons use 16-bit LoRA.
summary.zh-TW: 全參數微調比較涵蓋至 30 億參數；7B–65B 的對照為 16-bit LoRA。

limits.en: Do not claim demonstrated 65B full-fine-tuning equivalence.
limits.zh-TW: 不能據此宣稱已證實 65B 全參數微調等效。

review.scope: This claim and its limitation only; not the whole linked page.
